exposure: quality of prenatal and labor care
level of adherence to recommended protocols
breastfeeding in the first hour of life
outcome: complications after delivery of the 1st twin
cohort: The study included 118 twin pregnancies (72 monochorionic and 46 dichorionic) between 2019 and 2022.
finding: Monochorionic twin pregnancies experienced more adverse perinatal outcomes than dichorionic twin pregnancies, and adherence to prenatal care and labor protocols was associated with studied outcomes like complications after delivery and death.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the death of the 2nd twin (OR=0.25).
